proceedings.supporting_quote: By a decision dated 15 March 2001, the Banking Regulation and Supervision Board... resolved to transfer the management and control of İktisat Bankası T.A.Ş.
on 14 September 2001, the Fund resolved to recover 726,122,000 Turkish liras from the former shareholders
On 20 July 2006, the Supreme Administrative Court... quashed the administrative court’s earlier decision
On 19 July 2007, the Fund decided to establish two economic and commercial units: one for Viva TV and the other for Radio Viva.

On 1 August 2007, the Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye ( Türkiye Sınaî Kalkınma Bankası A.Ş ., hereinafter referred to as “TSKB”) issued a report and determined that the value of the Radio Viva Economic and Commercial Unit... was 4,258,000 United States dollars (USD), while the value of the Viva TV Economic and Commercial Unit... was USD 373,400.
On 29 August 2007, the Fund resolved to offer both Viva TV and Radio Viva for sale together in a single tendering process

On 3 April 2008, the Fund concluded that the Erol Aksoy Group had failed to fulfil several commitments and obligations set out in the Liquidation Protocol... Consequently, the Fund decided to rely on its provisions concerning default.
On 18 September 2008, the Fund further resolved to transfer the management and control of all companies within the Erol Aksoy Group to itself
On 30 June 2009, a valuation report issued by TSKB determined that the value of Radio Viva was USD 5,782,000 and the value of Viva TV was USD 132,000.
On 9 July 2009, the Fund decided to merge the two economic and commercial units, thereby creating the Viva TV-Radio Viva Economic and Commercial Unit
On 5 November 2009, the Fund resolved to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale
On 13 January 2011, the Fund decided to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale again
on 3 May 2012, the Fund approved the award of Viva TV-Radio Viva to company A.

On 24 February 2011, the applicant initiated proceedings before the administrative court, seeking the annulment of the sale of Viva TV-Radio Viva... On 19 March 2014, the 6th Chamber of the İstanbul Administrative Court dismissed the applicant’s claim
On 9 December 2014, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court dismissed the applicant’s case.
On 7 July 2015, following an appeal by the applicant, the General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court... annulled the Fund’s decision.
On 18 April 2016, the Fund notified the applicant of a decision taken on 27 October 2015 regarding the impossibility of enforcing the judgment.
On 25 January 2016, the Supreme Administrative Court rejected the Fund’s request for rectification
On 30 June 2017, the 13 th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court granted the request
the Fund responded, stating that a decision had already been made on 11 August 2017 regarding the enforcement of the relevant judgment... the annulment decision could not be enforced
On 11 September 2017, the applicant lodged an individual application with the Constitutional Court... the Constitutional Court declared the application inadmissible
The Constitutional Court concluded that the administration’s failure to enforce the annulment decisions amounted to a violation of the applicant’s property rights under Article 35 of the Constitution
On an appeal by the applicant, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court upheld that decision on 9 December 2014.
the decision of the first-instance administrative court, which had dismissed the case on the grounds of his lack of standing

judgments delivered by the Supreme Administrative Court following proceedings initiated by the applicant to annul decisions related to the valuation, tender invitation and subsequent sale of a television channel and radio station
On 7 February 2011, the applicant initiated proceedings before the administrative court, contesting the actions of the Fund concerning the tendering of Viva TV-Radio Viva
the court overturned the judgment of the 6th Chamber of the Istanbul Administrative Court dated 19 March 2014 and annulled the sale in question
In a letter dated 7 August 2017, the applicant requested the Fund to enforce the annulment judgment
